title_sq: Apartament 1+1 ne shitje 21 Dhjetori ne Tirane
description_sq:
21 Dhjetori, Rruga Ylbere Bylykbashi, shitet apartament 1+1 me siperfaqe 64m2 kati i 5 ( i fundit ) i nje pallati egzistues. Organizohet nga korridori shperndares, soxhorno, dhome gjumi, tualet dhe ballkon. Apartamenti eshte totalisht i restauruar nga e para duke filluar nga instalime elektrike, hidraulike, dyer, dritare,etj.
Shitet 127 000 Euro!
title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale December 21 in Tirana
description_en: 21 December, Rruga Ylbere Bylykbashi, 1+1 apartment for sale with a surface area of ​​64m2, 5th floor (last) of an existing building. It is organized by distribution corridor, living room, bedroom, toilet and balcony. The apartment is completely restored from scratch, starting with electrical, plumbing, doors, windows, etc. For sale 127 000 Euro!
